tolerances.p_M4_df_ge_30: compared with the normal reference 2*norm.sf(|t|): |delta| <= 1e-6; deviation from exact Student-t recorded as KNOWN N-1 (not a pass/fail criterion)
tolerances.tcrit_beyond_table: recorded (M4 df>30 -> 1.960; M3 df>120 -> 1.960); known approximation
tolerances.slope_M4: raw _ols slope: |delta| <= 1e-8; exported structural_rate.slope_rnfl_per_year (rounded to 2 dp by _r2): |delta| <= 0.005
tolerances.sanity: every returned p is finite and within [0,1]; t=0 -> p=1
tolerances.p_M4_export_rounded_2dp: exported structural_rate.p_value is rounded to 2 dp by _r2: |p_export - p_ref| <= 0.005; raw _ols p uses p_exact_branch tolerance

T3.decision_endpoints: for every decision_endpoints row: (p_ofty < alpha) == (p_ref < alpha)

series_rules.M4-SLOPE*: classification equals documented band applied to the reference slope (> -1.0 stable_trend; (-2.0,-1.0] suspicious_trend; <= -2.0 fast_progression); raw/exported slope and p within tolerance
series_rules.M4-N4-FAST-PSIG: classification fast_progression (n<5 p-guard not triggered because p_ref < 0.05)
series_rules.M4-N4-FAST-PNS: classification suspicious_trend (n<5 p-guard triggered because p_ref >= 0.05)
series_rules.M4-CONST5, M4-CONST6-MONTHLY: p_value null or >= 0.05; statistical_significance != 'significant'; classification stable_trend
series_rules.M4-NEAREXACT, M4-N12-NOISY: raw _ols p within p_exact_branch tolerance; exported p within 2-dp tolerance; raw and exported slope within tolerance
series_rules.M4-N32-T2-APIONLY: record OFTY p and statistical_significance; expected by known N-1: p ~= p_norm (0.0455) and 'significant' whereas exact p = 0.0546 ('trend' under the documented 0.05/0.10 bands); reachability: engine API accepts n=32; UI addRow refuses the 13th row
series_rules.M3-N12-NOISY, M3-N3-24M: p within p_M3_rounded_4dp tolerance; slope within slope_M3_rounded_4dp
series_rules.M4-PEDGE-0.047: raw p within tolerance of 0.047; statistical_significance 'significant'; FAIL (STOP-3 finding, no change) if the exported/displayed p reads >= 0.05 for this significant result

T3.stop_rule: a reachable (UI/host) deviation beyond tolerance, a wrong decision at an endpoint, or a constant-series 'significant' result is a STOP-3 finding: no engine change, author decision requested. Known N-1 (df>=30) is recorded with its reachability qualification.

T4.mode: real gate2 host from G2B-WV1 (primary verdict) and from C1 (attribution only); M1/M2 as T1c-H1; M4 as T1c common
captured: M3 frame card: progression label, hero slope text, confidence, risk, interpretation
M3 export: localStorage ofty_m3_result and the published Gate2 envelope payload (classification, data_quality, confidence_level, functional.display.label/assessability, functional.candidate.state)
M5 result/COPY/JSON functional fields (primary_assessability, primary_state, native_classification, display.label) and M5 'Global MD (M3)' COPY line

decision_rule.STOP: the M3 card or COPY shows a categorical progression label other than 'Not assessable' (i.e. 'No progression detected' [internal Stable], 'Suspicious trend' or 'Progressing') while the exported native classification is 'unclassifiable' or the exported data_quality is 'insufficient'; or card label != COPY 'Progression:' label; or card label inconsistent with export functional.display.label under the documented display mapping (Stable -> 'No progression detected')
decision_rule.PASS: card and COPY show 'Not assessable' (or an equivalent non-categorical state) whenever the export is unclassifiable/insufficient, or the export is classified and all surfaces agree
decision_rule.on_STOP: no patch; report the observed mismatch, a minimal patch proposal and a test plan for author approval

stop_semantics: A STOP halts the affected block (remaining cases NOT_EVALUATED), forbids any fix or retry without logged author approval, and makes the package a STOP/PARTIAL package. Independent, already-frozen, non-mutating blocks may still be executed so that the author receives complete evidence; a STOP of type 5 (protected data/secret/external account) or 6 (harness failure) halts all execution.
